claims.text: The model architecture consists of an ensemble of decision tree classifiers and a deep learning component that uses a 1024-dimensional LSTM for question encoding and a CNN (VGG16) for image feature extraction.
The decision tree ensemble uses 25 trees and is implemented using random forests in Matlab.
The visual question answering (VQA) system adapts a deep learning architecture to combine visual and textual features for predictions.
